title: 3.2.0-dev-k Application expired
symptom: The 3.2.0-dev-k application expires on startup, dropping into 'Open Loop'.
cause: The version tag 'dev-k' was already used and has an expiry date of 2023-09-05, so the app thinks it has expired.
fix: The developer updated the version in the dev branch, fixing the mistake.
evidence_quote: Version tag "dev-k" was already used and has expiry date 2023-09-05. Needs fixing.
